head_commit.message:
config(repo-review): omitted repo decision defers again now the travel window has ended (#3425)

#3351 set defaults.omitted_repo_decision to 'approve' for 2026-09-04..2026-09-14 so the weekly
pipeline kept filing while the owner could not record decisions. The window ends 2026-09-14 and the
next weekly run is Thursday 2026-09-17, so reverting today changes no run. Supply no longer needs the
override: the fleet holds ~100 open implementation issues and the research program's Track D refills
demand-driven. The history_note records the window so the two states stay explained.

Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
